quandoUsar: A theme button near the bottom of the screen or in a lower corner, as in the demo, when the new theme should rise from the bottom edge.
When the transition should be a straight, simple movement that does not depend on where the button is.
quandoEvitar: Use `theme-switch` (`reveal` variant) when the transition should start at the click point.
Use `theme-switch-split` when the button sits at the center of a bar and a symmetric opening fits better.

teclado.acao: Trigger the button, which calls `onThemeChange` with the next theme and `"rise"`.

acessibilidade: It is the library's `button`, with `aria-pressed` true in the dark theme and `aria-hidden` icons; icon-only (`iconOnly`, as in the demo), `label` is the only name, so pass fixed text, like “Change appearance”.
Without `label`, the default name is built in English and changes with the state (“Switch to light mode”); outside `iconOnly`, the visible text is the fixed “Switch theme”.
movimento: With `variant="rise"`, the icon rises 2 px in the dark theme, on a spring curve, and drops when going back to light, while the sun and moon swap by rotating.

The page rise does not come with the component: in the demo, the new theme is revealed from bottom to top in 520 ms, clipping `::view-transition-new(root)` from `inset(100% 0 0 0)` to `inset(0 0 0 0)`.
With “reduce motion”, the icon only fades and the shift happens without transition; the demo's utility also swaps the theme without animating the page.
notasIA: It is the same `ThemeSwitch` with `variant="rise"`: import from `@/components/ryan-ui/theme-switch/theme-switch`; `onThemeChange` receives `"rise"` as the second argument.

Implement the rise in the app: inside `document.startViewTransition`, apply the theme and animate the `clip-path` of `::view-transition-new(root)`; since it does not start from the button, `trigger` can be ignored.
In the demo, the button floats in the bottom right corner of a frame (`position: absolute` on the parent); the component does not position itself.
